verdict.rationale: Restate's own docs describe per-invocation journal inspection, an invocations list covering running, suspended and completed invocations, and an Introspection SQL API for querying invocation state, so a per-run step history exists and can be queried. However, the evidence never shows a searchable, filterable dashboard, and never shows per-step inputs, outputs, retries and errors laid out as a timeline; a community comment also notes Step Functions offers execution-history visualization that Restate lacks. Missing for 10: explicit dashboard UI with search/filter, documented per-step timeline showing inputs/outputs/retry attempts/errors, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, every run has a step-by-step timeline — inputs, outputs, retries, and errors per step — in a dashboard my team can search and filter

citations.quote: Full visibility into agent execution. Inspect journals, export traces, and cancel or kill stuck agents.
Invocations list: See all running, suspended, and completed agent invocations
Restate exposes information on invocations and application state via its CLI and Introspection SQL API.
